messages:
Jordan: Hey team — customer hit a tool-call failure after we renamed a function yesterday. API returns `error: no matching tool found for 'AnalyzeEmail'` even though the registry shows the new name.
Priya: Which client were they using? casing might be different between registry and client.
Jordan: They used our Node SDK (v2.3.1). Original function name was `analyze-email` (kebab-case), we rolled a rename to `AnalyzeEmail` (PascalCase) during model onboarding.
Mae: Ugh, this is the classic name-alias sync issue. Registry change propagated but alias map TTL on Dedicated nodes still had old index.
Carlos: Can you paste the request payload and the exact error?
Jordan: Error body from their call:
```
HTTP 400
{
  "error": "no matching tool found",
  "detail": "requested tool: AnalyzeEmail, available tools: [analyze-email, summarize-doc]"
}
```
Jordan: Repro steps I ran locally (short):
1) POST /v1/call with body `{ "tool": "AnalyzeEmail", "args": {"text":"foo"} }`
2) SDK returns 400 with same message.

Priya: @eng-runtime-oncall did we have a registry rollout yesterday around the time the customer started failing? any casing normalization change? :eyes: 
eng-runtime-oncall: deploy-bot: registry-service v1.8.2 rolled at 2026-03-08T02:14Z. No intentional casing normalization changes, but a fast patch updated how aliases are indexed (lowercasing for lookup) — potential mismatch if callers use mixed-case and the lookup path didn't apply lowercasing in some code paths.
Mae: If the registry index stores both `analyze-email` and `AnalyzeEmail` as distinct entries but lookup lowercases only some entries, mismatch can happen. We also saw a short window where Dedicated nodes used stale alias caches.
Carlos: Short-term workaround for customer: call using the original kebab-case `analyze-email` OR set the `tool_alias` field to the kebab name. Also we can add a temporary server-side alias mapping for their org.
Jordan: Customer is on Dedicated and needs low latency fix. They asked for a patch rather than manual workaround.
Priya: Action items:
- eng-runtime: force alias cache invalidation on Dedicated pools for that org (hotfix).
- eng-runtime: add a migration to normalize casing consistently across lookups and registry entries.
- Support: propose temporary alias mapping for the customer's org.
- DevEx: add a note in SDK docs about case sensitivity until fixed.

Mae: I'll run a cache invalidation for that pool now and push a quick alias entry.
Mae: /api/internal/registry/invalidate?org=acme-corp&scope=aliases -> 200 (done) :white_check_mark:
Mae: Added alias mapping `AnalyzeEmail -> analyze-email` scoped to acme-corp.

Jordan: Customer retested — now call with `AnalyzeEmail` succeeds. They confirmed end-to-end. :tada:
Carlos: We'll keep monitoring logs for any other orgs hitting this. I'll add a search for `no matching tool found` + mixed-case tool name in the past 48h.
Priya: Long-term: schedule a patch to the registry lookup code and a rolling restart plan for Dedicated nodes so caches don't diverge after future renames.
Jordan: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the customer with the workaround and ETA for the permanent fix.
SupportBot: Ticket INC-2026-2147 updated with notes and workaround. Assigned to eng-runtime.
